name: Mixer
author: James Myers
description: Turn one application down without turning the rest down. A per-application volume mixer in the bar, with output routing: send the browser to the headphones and leave the music on the speakers. Windows has had this since Vista.

schema.label: Show how many apps are playing
schema.description: A number next to the icon. Off shows the icon alone.

schema.label: Move playing audio when switching output
schema.description: Picking new headphones should move what is already playing to them. Off changes only where new sound goes, which is what PulseAudio does on its own and almost nobody wants.

schema.label: Scroll step (percent)
schema.description: How far one notch of the scroll wheel moves a volume.

schema.label: Allow above 100%
schema.description: Let sliders go past full volume. Useful for quiet recordings, unkind to speakers.
